# Retro Player — Unabridged Technical Specification & LLM Reference (v1.1.1)

> **Repository**: https://github.com/godarayudhvir/retro-player  
> **Live Web Demo**: https://godarayudhvir.github.io/retro-player/  
> **Target Audience**: AI agents, LLM search engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude), developers, and retro gaming enthusiasts.

---

## 1. System Overview & Architectural Model

**Retro Player** is a high-performance, zero-overhead web emulation station that transforms modern web browsers into a console-grade retro gaming machine. It operates under a **client-side WebAssembly execution model**, ensuring the host server incurs near-zero CPU and memory usage during gameplay.

### Core Architectural Principles
1. **Edge WebAssembly Execution**: Game ROMs execute 100% inside client browser sandbox threads using compiled WebAssembly cores (`EmulatorJS`).
2. **Tri-Environment Universal Compatibility**:
   - **Local Development**: `http://localhost:3000` via Vite dev server (`vite.config.js`).
   - **Self-Hosted Production / Docker**: `http://<server-ip>:3000` via multi-stage Express container (`server.js`).
   - **Static Hosting / GitHub Pages**: `https://<user>.github.io/retro-player/` with relative subpath routing (`./`).
3. **Zero-Lag Spatial Navigation**: Full 2D controller and keyboard spatial navigation across all components, modals, and virtual keyboards.
4. **Permanent Dual-Layer Persistence**: Automatic synchronization between local browser IndexedDB (`RetroPlayerDB`) and optional host filesystem (`data/retroplayer_db.json`).

---

## 2. Supported Platforms, File Extensions & Cores

Retro Player supports 12 classic gaming platforms:

| Platform | Canonical Key | Core Engine | Extensions Supported | Category |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Nintendo Entertainment System** | `nes` | FCEUmm / QuickNES | `.nes`, `.zip` | Home Console |
| **Super Nintendo Entertainment System** | `snes` | Snes9x | `.sfc`, `.smc`, `.snes`, `.zip` | Home Console |
| **Game Boy Advance** | `gba` | mGBA / VBA-M | `.gba`, `.zip` | Handheld |
| **Game Boy Color** | `gbc` | Gambatte | `.gbc`, `.zip` | Handheld |
| **Game Boy** | `gb` | Gambatte | `.gb`, `.zip` | Handheld |
| **Nintendo 64** | `n64` | Mupen64Plus | `.z64`, `.n64`, `.v64`, `.zip` | Home Console |
| **Nintendo DS** | `nds` | DeSmuME / melonDS | `.nds`, `.zip` | Dual-Screen Handheld |
| **Sega Genesis / Mega Drive** | `genesis` | Genesis Plus GX | `.md`, `.smd`, `.gen`, `.zip` | Home Console |
| **Sega Game Gear** | `gamegear` | Genesis Plus GX | `.gg`, `.zip` | Handheld |
| **Atari 2600** | `atari2600` | Stella | `.a26`, `.bin`, `.zip` | Home Console |
| **Sony PlayStation 1** | `psx` | PCSX ReARMed | `.iso`, `.cue`, `.chd`, `.pbp` | 32-Bit CD Console |
| **Arcade / MAME** | `arcade` | FB Alpha / MAME2003 | `.zip` | Coin-Op Arcade |

## 3. Controls & Spatial Navigation

The entire application is 100% controllable via physical gamepads (Xbox, DualShock/DualSense, Nintendo Switch Pro, 8BitDo) and desktop keyboards.

### Gamepad Button Layout (Standard XInput / W3C Standard Gamepad)
- **D-Pad / Left Stick**: 2D Spatial Grid Navigation & Carousel Selection
- **A / South Button**: Confirm / Launch Selected Game / Select Character Tile
- **B / East Button**: Back / Dismiss Modal / Return to Library
- **X / West Button**: Toggle Favorite Status / Virtual Space Bar (in OSK)
- **Y / North Button**: Open On-Screen Virtual Keyboard Search
- **L1 / Left Bumper**: Previous System Category / Cycle Left
- **R1 / Right Bumper**: Next System Category / Cycle Right
- **L3 / Left Stick Click**: Toggle Cartridge Grid Density (Compact / Cozy / Large)
- **R3 / Right Stick Click**: Toggle Panoramic Wide Grid Mode
- **L3 + R3 (Simultaneous)**: Force Exit Active Game back to Library
- **Start / Menu**: Open Console Settings & Management Drawer
- **Select / Back**: Focus Search Bar / Toggle Active Sub-toolbar

### Keyboard Shortcuts
- **Arrow Keys**: Spatial Tile Navigation
- **Enter**: Confirm / Launch Game / Submit
- **Escape**: Close Modal / Back
- **F**: Toggle Favorite Status
- **/**: Focus Search Input / Open Virtual Keyboard
- **Tab / Shift+Tab**: Switch System Category Tabs
- **1, 2, 3**: Switch Grid Density Sizes

---

## 4. Save States & Cartridge Battery Architecture

Retro Player decouples snapshot quick saves from authentic in-game battery saves:

1. **Battery SRAM (`.sav` / `.srm` / `.mcr`)**:
   - Emulates battery-backed RAM on physical cartridges.
   - Automatically flushed on in-game save events and on game exit.
   - Saved into IndexedDB `game_saves` store and synchronized to `data/retroplayer_db.json`.
2. **Snapshot Save States (`.state`)**:
   - Captures entire CPU/RAM/VRAM memory state for instant resume.
   - Saved into IndexedDB `save_states` store.
3. **Backup & Migration Studio**:
   - 1-Click JSON export of all saves, profiles, playtime, and settings (`data/retroplayer_db.json`).
   - Drag-and-drop JSON restore to migrate libraries across browsers or devices.

---

## 5. Pokémon Save Inspector Specifications

Retro Player includes an in-memory binary parser for Pokémon save files across Generations 1 through 5:

- **Generation 1 (Red / Blue / Yellow)**:
  - Validates checksum algorithm across offsets `0x2598` to `0x3523`.
  - Reads 8 Kanto Gym Badges from bitfield byte `0x2602`.
  - Unlocks Hall of Fame champion milestone upon detecting League victory flag.
- **Generation 2 (Gold / Silver / Crystal)**:
  - Reads 8 Johto Gym Badges from `0x23E4` and 8 Kanto Badges from `0x23E5` (16 total badges).
  - Unlocks Mt. Silver and Red Defeated milestones.
- **Generation 3 (Ruby / Sapphire / Emerald / FireRed / LeafGreen)**:
  - Parses 4KB cyclic save chunks and 14-block sections with 32-bit save counters.
  - Verifies section checksums and parses Hoenn / Kanto badges and National Pokédex flags.
- **Generation 4 & 5 (Diamond / Pearl / Platinum / HeartGold / SoulSilver / Black / White)**:
  - Parses `.dsv` footer structures, Desmume metadata blocks, and Unova Gym Badges.

---

## 6. Universal Organic Achievements Engine

Retro Player features a master registry of **24 universal organic achievements** (300G Gamerscore) across 6 categories:
1. **First Boot**: Complete onboarding and launch your first retro title (10G).
2. **Marathon Gamer**: Log over 30 continuous minutes in a single game session (15G).
3. **Retro Polyglot**: Play games across 5 distinct console platforms (20G).
4. **Physical Tactility**: Connect and play using a hardware USB or Bluetooth controller (15G).
5. **Collector's Vault**: Ingest or manage a library of 25+ retro games (25G).
6. **Save Custodian**: Perform an authentic in-game cartridge battery save (15G).
7. **Pokémon Milestones**: Defeat Gym Leaders, obtain Badges, and enter the Hall of Fame (up to 50G).

Session achievements buffer in memory during gameplay to prevent distracting overlays, flushing with authentic Web Audio chiptune fanfares upon game exit.

---

## 7. Dual Server & Docker Deployment

### Multi-Stage Container Setup
Retro Player runs via a hardened, non-root multi-stage Docker container:

```yaml
version: '3.8'
services:
  retro-player:
    image: ghcr.io/godarayudhvir/retro-player:latest
    container_name: retro-player
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/app/data
      - ./roms:/app/public/roms
      - ./bgm:/app/public/bgm
    environment:
      - NODE_ENV=production
      - PORT=3000
      - INCLUDE_DEMO_ROMS=true
      - INCLUDE_DEMO_BGM=true
```

### Environment Variables
- `PORT`: Server listening port (default: `3000`)
- `DATA_DIR`: Filesystem path for JSON database (default: `/app/data`)
- `ROMS_DIR`: Filesystem directory for local ROM binaries (default: `/app/public/roms`)
- `BGM_DIR`: Filesystem directory for background music tracks (default: `/app/public/bgm`)
- `INCLUDE_DEMO_ROMS`: Enable/disable bundled open-source homebrew ROMs (`true`/`false`)
- `INCLUDE_DEMO_BGM`: Enable/disable bundled ambient audio tracks (`true`/`false`)

---

## 8. REST API Reference

All backend API endpoints operate with path traversal guards and origin validation:

- `GET /api/roms`: Scans ROM directory and returns catalog manifest with companion sidecars and covers.
- `GET /api/bgm`: Scans audio directories and returns available background music tracks.
- `GET /api/db/:store`: Fetches records for a given store (`profiles`, `user_data`, `game_saves`, `app_settings`).
- `POST /api/db/:store`: Commits or updates a record in the server database.
- `POST /api/db/export`: Exports the full JSON database.
- `POST /api/db/import`: Imports a full JSON database payload.
- `POST /api/db/reset`: Soft-resets the server database.
- `POST /api/upload-rom`: Ingests a new ROM binary into the server library.
- `POST /api/delete-rom`: Deletes a ROM and companion sidecars from disk.
- `POST /api/metadata/save-sidecar`: Saves or updates game metadata sidecar JSON and cover art.
- `POST /api/metadata/delete-sidecar`: Reverts game metadata and removes companion files.
- `POST /api/presence`: Dispatches Discord RPC and game activity state.
